fact: A new project to modernise the Integrated Tax and Duty Management System (SIGIT), estimated at about 4.7 billion FCFA and backed by technical partners, aims to strengthen interconnection of tax services and automate procedures, per L'Economie.
system: Système Intégré de Gestion des Impôts et Taxes (SIGIT)

fact: Tele-declaration was introduced progressively from fiscal year 2016 for taxpayers of the Large Taxpayers Directorate (DGE) and extended from 2022 to the Local and Individual Taxpayer Centres, per L'Economie.
Tele-payment was introduced progressively from fiscal year 2016 for DGE taxpayers and extended from 2022 to the Local and Individual Taxpayer Centres, per L'Economie.

LeFisk describes ATOM as the tax directorate's online filing (tele-declaration) system already in use for declarations, before the new registrations platform; no date is given, so the article's published date is used.
LeFisk reports that registration duties for 3 public-procurement acts are assessed and paid online through the tax directorate DGI platform registrations.dgi.cm, by mobile money or DGI OTP.
